name: University of Canterbury
description: The University of Canterbury is a public research university in Christchurch, established in 1873 as Canterbury College. It has about 20,800 students across six faculties including engineering, science and business.
whyIncluded: UC offers articulation pathways for engineering diploma holders from Singapore's five polytechnics into its Bachelor of Engineering (Hons), and New Zealand is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 360 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for one student sharing a flat, over 12 months: rent, power, internet, food, transport, phone and insurance. Excludes bond, furnishings, books, parking and clothing.
livingCosts.notes: UC 'Flatting - estimate of costs' (page dated 15 July 2026; single person sharing a 4-bedroom house in Ilam), weekly x 52/12. Housing: rent $200 + power $20 + internet $8/wk. Food: $145/wk. Transport: $25/wk. Personal: mobile phone $8 + contents and liability insurance $10 + other/incidentals $20/wk. UC's weekly total is $436. Excludes one-off and annual extras (bond $800, rent in advance $400, furnishings $750, books $750, parking $560, clothing $750). UC's halls estimate is $525/wk.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Data Science
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students for the 2027 intake; the actual fee depends on courses chosen and rises yearly. Student services levy included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 international tuition fee estimate per 120 points (BDataSc, 360 points = 3 years); actual fee depends on courses. UC also publishes 2028: $46,125. Compulsory = Student Services Levy for on-campus study, $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 in 2026 (2027 rate not yet published). Excludes insurance. No 2024/2025 history: the BDataSc estimate blends Science and Business fee bands and UC no longer publishes earlier years' per-qualification estimates; the UC Calendar fee bands give no single BDataSc figure.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering with Honours
programmes.summary: First-year tuition only. Years 2 to 4 cost more (about NZ$54,180 a year in 2027), so the total will be above this estimate. Student services levy included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 international tuition fee estimate per 120 points for the FIRST year of the BE(Hons) (480 points = 4 years); UC quotes second to fourth years higher at $54,180 (2026: $51,900; 2028: $56,890), which this single annual figure does not capture. Compulsory = 2026 Student Services Levy $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 (2027 not yet published). Excludes insurance. No 2024/2025 history: the first-year BE(Hons) estimate blends fee bands (the Calendar's Engineering band, $48,000 in 2024 and $49,900 in 2025, is the second-to-fourth-year rate) and UC no longer publishes earlier years' per-qualification estimates.

programmes.name: Master of Computer Science
programmes.summary: Programme fee paid at the start, spread over 1.5 years (the programme takes 12 to 18 months). Student services levy included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 Special Programme Fee $71,400 for the whole 180-point PMCS (paid at the start, 12-18 months), divided by 1.5 years. 2026 = $67,950 / 1.5; 2028 published as $75,000. Compulsory = 2026 Student Services Levy $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 (2027 not yet published). Excludes insurance. 2024 and 2025 rows are the UC Calendar Fees and Fines Regulations Schedule 1 Part C international fee band 4 (Science) postgraduate rate per 120 points; the PMCS is not in the Calendar's special-programme list and its 2026 web fee equals band 4 x 1.5 (180 points: 2024 $63,300, 2025 $65,700 in total). SSL then $9.17/point x 120 = $1,100.40.
